description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the Notification controller within the Admin section of the OpenCart project. It handles fetching notifications from an external API and managing session cookies related to notifications.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling notifications in the admin interface, including fetching updates from the OpenCart server and managing notification cookies.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that checks for notification cookie, fetches notifications from the server if cookie is absent, processes the notifications, and sets the cookie.
